# Web passage structures

These are small synthetic documents with original test prose, not website snapshots.
They model structures encountered in review investigations: the GNU Bash manual
(https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/manual/bash.html), Playwright fixtures and
timeouts (https://playwright.dev/docs/test-fixtures and /docs/test-timeouts),
GitHub job permissions, and the GitHub artifact-v4 announcement.
Tests generate large filler locally. No test requires a live website.
